Details
  • Paper: ViTPose: Simple Vision Transformer Baselines for Human Pose Estimation, NeurIPS 2022, 2022-04-26 (for vitpose-base-simple, vitpose-base)
  • Paper: ViTPose++: Vision Transformer for Generic Body Pose Estimation, TPAMI 2023, 2022-12-07 (for vitpose-plus-small, vitpose-plus-base, vitpose-plus-large, vitpose-plus-huge)
  • Original code: https://github.com/huggingface/transformers at v4.57.1
  • Authors' code, not used: https://github.com/ViTAE-Transformer/ViTPose (PyTorch): The authors' code is built on mmpose; the Hugging Face transformers port is dependency-light and ships the converted weights.
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://huggingface.co/usyd-community/vitpose-base-simple (model card licence)
  • Training data: COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification) (COCO 2017 keypoints; the ViT was initialised from MAE ImageNet-1k pre-training)
    • vitpose-plus-small: COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), AI Challenger human keypoints (2017), MPII Human Pose, AP-10K (animal pose), APT-36K (animal pose tracking), COCO-WholeBody, ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification) (ViTPose++: one backbone trained jointly on COCO, AI Challenger, MPII, AP-10K, APT-36K and COCO-WholeBody (one MLP expert per dataset), from MAE ImageNet-1k pre-training; only the COCO expert and head are used)
    • vitpose-plus-base: COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), AI Challenger human keypoints (2017), MPII Human Pose, AP-10K (animal pose), APT-36K (animal pose tracking), COCO-WholeBody, ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification) (ViTPose++: one backbone trained jointly on COCO, AI Challenger, MPII, AP-10K, APT-36K and COCO-WholeBody (one MLP expert per dataset), from MAE ImageNet-1k pre-training; only the COCO expert and head are used)
    • vitpose-plus-large: COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), AI Challenger human keypoints (2017), MPII Human Pose, AP-10K (animal pose), APT-36K (animal pose tracking), COCO-WholeBody, ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification) (ViTPose++: one backbone trained jointly on COCO, AI Challenger, MPII, AP-10K, APT-36K and COCO-WholeBody (one MLP expert per dataset), from MAE ImageNet-1k pre-training; only the COCO expert and head are used)
    • vitpose-plus-huge: COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), AI Challenger human keypoints (2017), MPII Human Pose, AP-10K (animal pose), APT-36K (animal pose tracking), COCO-WholeBody, ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification) (ViTPose++: one backbone trained jointly on COCO, AI Challenger, MPII, AP-10K, APT-36K and COCO-WholeBody (one MLP expert per dataset), from MAE ImageNet-1k pre-training; only the COCO expert and head are used)
  • Options: fp32_accumulate = False (precision only)
  • Kernel libraries: fvm_conv
  • Variants: vitpose-base-simple, vitpose-base, vitpose-plus-small, vitpose-plus-base, vitpose-plus-large, vitpose-plus-huge
  • Outputs: keypoints, keypoint_scores, boxes, scores; label_set: coco-keypoints-17
  • Input size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): vitpose-base-simple 3000x4000 (4.5 GiB peak allocated, 4.8 reserved); vitpose-base 3000x4000 (4.5 GiB peak allocated, 4.8 reserved); vitpose-plus-small 3000x4000 (4.4 GiB peak allocated, 4.6 reserved); vitpose-plus-base 3000x4000 (4.5 GiB peak allocated, 4.8 reserved); vitpose-plus-large 3000x4000 (4.9 GiB peak allocated, 5.2 reserved); vitpose-plus-huge not measured yet

Measured

Top-down on the ground-truth person boxes (non-crowd, at least one labelled keypoint), no flip test; people ranked by the mean of their 17 keypoint scores (not mmpose's rescoring and OKS-NMS), so not the papers' AP; pycocotools OKS AP; whole-body models scored on their 17 body keypoints. Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.

Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.005 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.13 and p99 <= 0.75 (absolute error of the output keypoints).
